announcements.title: Bank of Canada raises the policy rate by 25 basis points to 2½%
announcements.summary: The Bank of Canada today increased its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%, with the Bank Rate at 2.75% and the deposit rate at 2.45%.

announcements.title: Bank of Canada maintains the policy rate at 2¼%
announcements.summary: The Bank of Canada today held its target for the overnight rate at 2.25%, with the Bank Rate at 2.5% and the deposit rate at 2.20%.
